title: About Me
html:
Menelik Admasu

BSc Computer Science
Bahir Dar University
2022 – 2026

Full-Stack App Developer · Computer Administrator
Hardware & Networking · Technical Trainer
Bahir Dar, Ethiopia

I am a multitasking, detail-oriented computer administrator who keeps systems running smoothly. With strong administrative skills and solid professional experience as IT staff, you can rely on me to handle responsibilities effectively and efficiently.

I am also a full-stack app developer. I build complete applications — from user interfaces and front-end experiences to back-end logic, APIs, and deployment.

I completed a Bachelor of Science in Computer Science at Bahir Dar University (2022 – 2026), after earlier formal training in computer hardware and networking. I enjoy website design, video editing, programming, and building practical tools such as this portfolio.

Interests

  • Full-stack web and app development
  • Programming and computer coding
  • UI/UX and interactive interfaces
  • Computer networking and maintenance
  • Cybersecurity
  • Website design and video editing
  • Learning new technologies, reading, and trying new things

Languages

  • Amharic — professional working proficiency
  • English — professional working proficiency

Volunteer work

I provide technology training for communities and organizations, helping people learn how to use technology effectively.
